name: Connect The Dots
description: Connect The Dots turns your network into warm introduction paths - built for individuals, teams, companies, and VC/PE firms. Ask who you know at any target company, find the strongest connector to a specific person, and support your portfolio companies by mapping who you can reach on their behalf. Draft and send ghost emails for intros, track job changes across your network, and run natural-language searches over your relationship graph - all without leaving your AI assistant. Powered by CTD's relationship intelligence platform, it surfaces the shortest path to anyone, so you can skip the cold outreach and get a warm intro instead.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Connect The Dots to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Connect The Dots to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.ctd.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Connect The Dots MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Connect The Dots lists 38 MCP tools, including add_ghost_email_participant, bulk_update_company_stage, create_ghost_email_draft, decline_ghost_email_approval, get_approvers_for_connector, get_company_details, get_company_info, get_job_changes, get_paths_by_connector, get_paths_by_stage, get_paths_to_company, and get_paths_to_contact.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Connect The Dots?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Connect The Dots in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Connect The Dots MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Connect The Dots requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Connect The Dots is developed by Connect The Dots. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
